title: Fare Bands for Bag Weight and Size Charges — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Pricing schedule — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand, weight and size charges.** The weight-or-size list charge of a checked bag is multiplied by the **fare band rate**, which follows the fare collected on the ticket, every fare-collection and add-collect entry. The rate acts on the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Fare collected on the ticket (USD) | Fare band rate |
|---|---|
| 600 or more (high fare floor) | 0.95 |
| At least 400 (middle fare floor) and below 600 | 0.97 |
| Below 400 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Fare collected | Rate |
|---|---|
| 600.00 | 0.95 |
| 599.99 | 0.97 |
| 400.00 | 0.97 |
| 399.99 | 1 |

A fare collection of 380.00 dollars followed by an add-collect of 30.00 dollars gives a fare collected of 410.00 dollars and a rate of 0.97 (hypothetical).
